WORDS.lucia1: Imagine Pecan Grove in 2035. Jayden is grown up, and so are you!
WORDS.theo1: Today the town draws a plan for 2035. Every neighbor shares one wish.
WORDS.plan: Plan 5 places so every neighbor's wish is in the plan. Use all your skills: listen, weigh, include and check. There's no wrong choice for the old farm.
WORDS.s1: Tap a place, then pick a tile for it.
WORDS.theo2: A plan needs care over time. Add one yearly check-in.
WORDS.lucia3: Who isn't at the table yet? Invite one person.
WORDS.who: Who else lives in Pecan Grove?

WORDS.real: Draw your town in 2035 and share it with your family or class. When you're in high school, you can apply to a youth commission. Ask a grown-up.

WORDS.guText: Kids plan Pecan Grove in 2035 using every skill. The old farm can hold a data center as planned or with changes, stay a farm, or wait for a study. Every choice can earn full points if every neighbor is heard. In Fulton County, high school students can apply to the county Youth Commission. In Georgia, county plans usually look about 20 years ahead and are updated every five years.
